description: This file contains core functions for processing, validating, and exporting data within the BORIS behavioral observation software project. It manages file operations, data validation, project integrity checks, and utility functions for handling observations, media files, and project data structure.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity( events: List[list], state_events_list: list = [], )
methods.description: Calculates the observation exhaustivity percentage based on events and state events list.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity_pictures(obs)
methods.description: Checks how exhaustively observations from pictures are coded, returning percentage or status messages.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] behavior_category(ethogram: dict)
methods.description: Returns a dict mapping behavior codes to their behavioral categories from an ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_if_media_available(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Verifies the presence of media files and images for a given observation.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_directories_availability(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if the directories used in an observation are available and accessible.

methods.name: bool check_coded_behaviors_in_obs_list(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Verifies that behaviors coded in observations are defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: list get_modifiers_of_behavior(ethogram, behavior: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all modifiers associated with a specific behavior from an ethogram.

methods.name: set check_coded_behaviors(pj: dict)
methods.description: Returns a set of behaviors used in observations not defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_state_events_obs(obsId: str, ethogram: dict, observation: dict, time_format: str = cfg.HHMMSS)
methods.description: Checks if state behaviors in an observation are properly paired and defined.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,tuple] check_state_events(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Checks multiple observations for unpaired state events and their consistency.

methods.name: str check_project_integrity( pj: dict, time_format: str, project_file_name: str, media_file_available: bool = True, )
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of project data including behaviors, timestamps, media, and subjects.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] create_subtitles(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, export_dir: str)
methods.description: Generates subtitle files for selected observations, exporting in specified formats.

methods.name: bool export_observations_list(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, file_name: str, output_format: str)
methods.description: Exports a list of selected observations to a specified file in various formats.

methods.name: bool set_media_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Adjusts media and image directory paths to be relative to the project file location.

methods.name: bool set_data_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Adjusts data file paths to be relative to the project file location.

methods.name: None remove_data_files_path(pj: dict)
methods.description: Removes file paths from data files in observations.

methods.name: bool remove_media_files_path(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Removes or normalizes media file paths and image directories in observations.

methods.name: str full_path(path: str, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Returns the absolute path for a given media/data/file path, resolving relative paths to project directory.

methods.name: Tuple[dec,dec] observed_interval(observation: dict)
methods.description: Calculates the start and end time of observed events within an observation.

methods.name: List[tuple] events_start_stop(ethogram: dict, events: list, obs_type: str)
methods.description: Processes a list of events to assign START/STOP or POINT type labels based on behavior types.

methods.name: list extract_observed_subjects(pj: dict, selected_observations: list)
methods.description: Extracts the list of unique subjects from selected observations.

methods.name: tuple open_project_json(project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Loads and processes a project file, handling compression and format conversions.
